description: IAM user 'dev-intern-jpark' is simultaneously flagged by two detection engines with opposing signals: (1) the endpoint-detection engine reports a known corporate device fingerprint with normal behavior, and (2) the geo-anomaly engine reports a login from a foreign IP 91.108.4.22 (Warsaw) at the same timestamp. Both events carry the same session token, suggesting either a VPN or a session hijack.

context.note: contradictory signals on same session — agent must weigh and not dismiss either
